title: Construction of normalized rational signed transposition calculus
statement: Fix D,l,X,E,w and normalized rational Verdier Datum A [def-sf-rational-verdier-data]. Suppose its supplied ordinary signed symmetry [def-sf-integral-verdier-models] is natural in both ambient derived variables. Conjugate that signed swap by the invertible completion maps to construct completedInterchange on integral constructible pairs. There is a rational PairingCalculus with swap equal, on every integral pair, to the localization of this constructed interchange; swap is natural in both raw rational variables. The actual specified bidual map untransposes to swap followed by evaluation: tensor(1_DK,delta_K);ev_DK=swap_DK,K;ev_K. Finally the normalized evaluation detects maps into DK. The calculus is assembled from these specified components, not chosen as an arbitrary symmetry.

proof.text: Apply the already proved raw bilinear natural-isomorphism localization theorem to the integral natural interchange and to the rational tensor and its flipped functor. Reverse the bilinear arrow map in the flipped input; commutativity of localized scalars gives its required pure-tensor formula. This constructs the normalized natural rational swap.

proof.text: Apply the inverse Hom-equivalence identity to the definition of IntegralVerdier.delta. Move the tensor arrow past inverse completion by naturality, and cancel the two adjacent completion isomorphisms. This proves the integral delta-evaluation equation. Localize it, using A.objects, A.bidual_integral, A.evaluation_integral and the rational tensor pure-tensor formula, to obtain the claimed rational equation. Equality and heterogeneous equality transport identify every endpoint explicitly.

theorem pairing_calculus (A : Datum D l hl X E w)
    (hA : ∀ (K M K' M' : IntegralHom.Derived.{u, u} X
        (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E X))
      (f : K ⟶ K') (g : M ⟶ M'),
      A.ordinary.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom f g) ≫ (A.symmetry.swap K' M').hom =
        (A.symmetry.swap K M).hom ≫ A.ordinary.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom g f)) :
    Nonempty (PairingCalculus D l hl X E w A)
